title: MobileCybench: Evaluating Agent Vulnerability Discovery via Executable Probes
abstract: arXiv:2609.23980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents now report vulnerabilities faster than maintainers can review them. Reports often depend on security properties specific to the application, and require considerable human labor to process. To mitigate this, we introduce a framework for evaluating vulnerability reports via probes, executable checks of security properties. A reported exploit is evaluated by replaying it against the application and running the probes: a triggered probe indicates both that the exploit succeeded and which security property it violated. As a probe encodes a security property rather than a known vulnerability, it can detect vulnerabilities that were not known when the probe was written. We instantiate the framework as MobileCybench, a benchmark for vulnerability discovery by AI agents in 13 Android applications, with 495 probes written and reviewed by the authors. We evaluate 5 coding agents (OpenCode with GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6-Sol, and GLM-5.2; Claude

translated_title: MobileCybench：通过可执行探针评估智能体漏洞发现能力
translated_abstract: AI智能体报告漏洞的速度已经超过了维护者审查的速度。漏洞报告通常依赖于应用程序特定的安全属性，并且需要大量人力来处理。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了一个通过探针评估漏洞报告的框架，探针是安全属性的可执行检查。报告的漏洞利用通过在应用程序上重放并运行探针来进行评估：被触发的探针既表明漏洞利用成功，也表明它违反了哪个安全属性。由于探针编码的是安全属性而非已知漏洞，它可以检测到编写探针时尚未知道的漏洞。我们将该框架实例化为MobileCybench，这是一个用于评估AI智能体在13个Android应用程序中发现漏洞能力的基准测试，包含作者编写并审查的495个探针。我们评估了5个编码智能体（OpenCode配合GPT-5.5、GPT-5.6-Sol和GLM-5.2；Claude……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了MobileCybench，一个基于可执行探针的评估框架与基准测试，通过重放漏洞利用并检测安全属性是否被违反，客观评估AI智能体在13个Android应用中的漏洞发现能力，且探针能检测编写时尚未知的漏洞。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MobileCybench, a probe-based evaluation framework and benchmark that objectively assesses AI agents' vulnerability discovery across 13 Android apps by replaying reported exploits against executable security-property checks, enabling detection of previously unknown vulnerabilities.
